name: Walk to Senado Square

I experimented with different angles and observed the flow of tourists to find clean compositions, taking approximately 150 photos in total.

Avoid the main tourist crowds and circle to the right into Travessa da Paixão (Lover's Lane), using the colorful walls as a foreground to photograph the side of the ruins. Then, ascend the small hillside to capture an elevated perspective, focusing on highlighting the contrast between the historical weathering of the architecture and the surrounding modern life.

description: At a popular restaurant, I ordered the signature Portuguese curry brisket with rice and serradura pudding. Consciously controlling my intake, I requested half the portion of rice and extra vegetable salad, carefully savoring the unique Portuguese flavors of Macau. The brisket was tender and flavorful, while the curry sauce was rich and aromatic. In the end, I finished the brisket and vegetables, leaving half of the rice uneaten, with the dessert serving as a perfect conclusion to the meal.
location: Tomato House Portuguese Cuisine (Main Store), No. 6 Lian'an Back Alley, Cathedral Parish, Macao Special Administrative Region

Then move into Calçada da Igreja de São Lázaro to photograph the tranquil historical ambiance and color contrast of Portuguese-style architecture under warm yellow lighting, maintaining full focus on adjusting shooting parameters throughout the process.

Dinner intake was consciously controlled. Tomorrow, focus on lighter meals and plan morning shooting.” Subjectively felt a slight increase in weight. Using a telephoto lens, I captured the intricate details of the Portuguese-style azulejos on the facade of St. Francis of Assisi Church and the profile of an elderly reader inside the Coloane Library. Strolling along the street to the Coloane Pier, I photographed the colorful fishing boats and anglers. During the walk, a sudden downpour forced me to take shelter under the eaves of a narrow alley, where I captured scenes of pedestrians seeking refuge from the rain. As the rain eased, I explored the ruins of the old shipyards along Rua da Ponta da Cabrita, reflecting on history and change.
location: Macao Special Administrative Region, Parish of St. Francis (Coloane), Rua de Cinco de Outubro, St. Francis Chapel, Rua dos Pescadores, Coloane Pier, etc.

I then opened Lightroom to process the nightscape photos taken in Macau, immersing myself in the creative flow. Following that, I performed 15 minutes of pre-sleep yoga stretches to relax my shoulders and neck. Leaning against the headboard, I read *Principles* for about 20 minutes, gaining some insights on "embracing reality." After closing the book, I set the alarm for the next day, turned off the lights, and went to sleep.
location: Home, Jinsing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Waking Up and Light Activities in the Morning
description: Awakened by a combination of anticipation for the salon the previous evening and my biological clock. Briefly reviewed the key discussion points prepared for the salon while still in bed. Got up at 06:20, weighed myself (75.0 kg), and drank a glass of warm water. Feeling reasonably rested, I decided to proceed with the planned morning run but adjusted the intensity appropriately.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Morning jog and discussion with friends about home purchase plans
description: Feng Haoran drove to the meeting point at the foot of Yuelu Mountain, where he had arranged to meet his running partner Gao Yunfei. The two then embarked on a 5-kilometer slow run along the gentle circular greenway at the mountain's base. During the run, Feng Haoran initiated a conversation about his ongoing search for a new home, inquiring about Gao Yunfei's views on the living environment, commuting convenience, and future appreciation potential of new districts such as Meixi Lake and Yanghu Lake. Drawing from his own residential experience and knowledge, Gao Yunfei provided a detailed comparison and practical suggestions, offering Feng Haoran valuable real-world insights.
location: No. 58 Denggao Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area (trail near the East Gate)

name: Washing Up, Breakfast, and Commute Preparation
description: After the morning run, I bid farewell to Gao Yunfei and drove back home. I took a quick shower and changed into professional attire. For breakfast, I prepared a protein shake, paired with whole wheat bread. Meanwhile, I listened to financial audio to stay updated on overnight developments in international markets.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Commuting to Work and Preliminary Office Affairs Handling
description: Left home at 08:05 and drove to the company in Kaifu District. The morning rush hour traffic was smooth, with a commute time of approximately 45 minutes. Listened to a financial podcast during the journey and brainstormed entry points for analyzing pension policies. Upon arrival, parked the car in the south ground parking lot of Junhao Garden. After reaching the workstation, reviewed global market data, economic news, and policy updates. Checked the work email to confirm that feedback on client Huang Siqi's proposal had been fully received, replied to urgent emails, and cleared the mental workspace for deep work.
location: Huatai Securities Office, Hunan Broadcasting Center Office Building, Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: In-depth Analysis of Pension Policies
description: Activate focused work mode. Conduct an in-depth analysis of the latest pension policy details item by item based on yesterday's framework. Evaluate the attractiveness of tax incentives for different income brackets. Analyze the specific impact of the policy-allowed investment scope on markets such as public funds and insurance asset management. Formulate well-structured electronic notes with business insights.
location: Company Office (Independent Workstation)

name: Review and issue the client asset allocation plan.
description: Switch to the document titled "Technology Theme Asset Allocation Plan" for client Huang Siqi. Review and confirm one by one that all feedback and revisions from the Legal, Compliance, and Product departments have been properly implemented, particularly the risk disclosure section. After verifying that everything is correct, generate the final PDF version. Attach a professional explanatory email and send it to client Huang Siqi, copying supervisor Qian Yongqiang. Then, inform Huang Siqi via WeChat that the plan has been sent and schedule an online presentation for the following day.
location: Company Office

name: Follow up on the listing progress of investment apartments at noon.
description: During the gap before lunch, Feng Haoran contacted real estate agent Lu Jiaming via WeChat to inquire about the listing progress. Lu Jiaming promptly replied and sent links to the listings on multiple mainstream platforms. Feng Haoran quickly reviewed them to confirm the key information was accurate, then replied, "Information noted, thanks for your hard work. Please keep me updated on any progress," efficiently completing the follow-up.
location: Company Office

name: Discuss industry insights with colleagues during lunch
description: I walked with my colleague Zheng Wenbo to our regular restaurant near the company for lunch. During the meal, I shared some key findings from analyzing the pension policy earlier in the morning. Zheng Wenbo raised practical implementation questions from a product perspective, and we had a brief but productive discussion.
location: Lanzhou Lamian Restaurant (or similar casual dining establishment) on Jinying Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Afternoon routine tasks, market review and planning
description: After walking back to the office, I closed my eyes and rested for 15 minutes at my workstation, taking deep breaths to relax and avoid feeling sluggish in the afternoon. I then handled daily inquiries from other clients and attended a brief product roadshow preparation meeting. After the market closed, I reviewed the day's performance of A-shares and the sectors I follow, updated the net asset values of client portfolios, and organized my thoughts on personal financial planning updates for the evening, particularly the preliminary allocation plan for funds after selling the apartment.
location: Company Office

name: Commuting Home After Work and a Simple Dinner
description: After completing the final tasks of the workday, I drove home to Yuelu District during the evening rush hour, which was quite congested. Upon arriving home, I quickly prepared pan-fried chicken breast and a vegetable salad for dinner. While eating, I browsed a photography forum on my tablet. After the meal, I tidied up briefly.
location: Home, Jinying Residential Community for District Government Staff, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Evening Personal Affairs: Camping Gear Organization, Itinerary Distribution, and Financial Planning Update
description: First, organize and check equipment for the weekend camping trip: inspect the tent, sleeping bag, moisture-proof mat, lighting equipment, etc., one by one to ensure they are in good condition. Focus on cleaning the camera lens and sensor, testing and charging spare batteries, clearing the memory card, and checking the drone's status. Then, pack all equipment into storage boxes by category. Next, send the final version of the Changsha itinerary document to my sister Feng Xinran and record a voice message to inform her. Finally, update the personal financial planning sheet, review today's tasks, and add a "Proceeds Pool from Apartment Sale" under the "Asset Replacement" project. Set a preliminary allocation draft: 60% for a down payment reserve for a new home, 25% for stable financial investments, and 15% as flexible funds for consumption and learning.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Participate in the FinTech Salon and engage in in-depth exchanges with entrepreneurs.
description: Change into appropriate smart casual business attire and drive to the FinTech Salon venue located at the Legal Services Building, No. 8 Ziwei Road, Furong District. Upon arriving punctually, attentively listen to the speeches on topics such as robo-advisors and the application of blockchain in finance, taking notes on key insights and technological trends. During the tea break, proactively engage in conversation with entrepreneur Li Zhe, delving into practical issues such as building customer trust and overcoming data barriers in robo-advisory services. Share client-side insights and gain novel perspectives from a technology entrepreneurship standpoint. At the end of the salon, exchange WeChat contacts, agreeing to stay in touch and continue further discussions.
location: A meeting room or shared space in the Legal Services Building, No. 8 Ziwei Road, Furong District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Returning Home and Pre-Sleep Preparation and Bedtime
description: After driving back home in Yuelu District from the salon venue, I felt slightly restless and had little desire to sleep due to the excitement from the evening's conversations. I performed a simple wash-up, engaged in five minutes of light stretching to relax my body, and checked that the alarm for the next day was set for 6:30. Lying in bed, I reflected on the day's accomplishments: completing policy analysis, client proposals, and financial planning updates, checking camping equipment, arranging my sister's itinerary, gaining new industry insights and expanding my network at the salon. With a sense of satisfaction and lingering excitement, I gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Jinsing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Morning Preparation, Morning Run, and Equipment Inspection
description: Woke up at 06:00, weighed 74.9 kg, and performed dynamic stretching. Subsequently, went for a 30-minute recovery morning run around Huangpitang Park and its vicinity near home while listening to the morning financial news briefing. After returning home, quickly freshened up, had milk oatmeal, boiled eggs, and a banana for breakfast, and completed the final check and loading of camping gear before departure.
location: At home in the Jinsing Residential Community of YueLu District Government, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, YueLu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, and around Huangpitang Park.

name: Drive to the assembly point and gather with the camping team.
description: Driving a private SUV from home, I took routes including the West Second Ring Road and the Fuyuan Road Bridge, arriving approximately 30 minutes later at the designated meeting point in Kaifu District—the parking lot outside the St. Jofeisi Café. There, I met up with the camping team members (organizer Xie Yutong, runner Gao Yunfei, the couple Chen Fan and Su Rui, and designer Zhao Yu). We assisted in checking and distributing the shared supplies for the two vehicles and engaged in a brief exchange. The team consisted of six people and two vehicles, setting off in convoy at 08:30.
location: From the Jinyuan Residential Community for Government Employees at No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, to the outdoor parking lot of the Shengjuefeisi Café on the first floor of Shengjuefeisi House, Jinying Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province.

name: On the Way to Mangshan by Car: Industry Exchange and Service Area Break
description: As the lead driver, I alternated driving duties with the co-driver Gao Yunfei, heading south along the G4 Expressway. During the journey, we engaged in in-depth industry discussions on topics such as the impact of personal pension account policies on the asset management industry and the development trends of robo-advisors. We arrived at the Hengshan Service Area around 10:30 for a 20-minute break. During this time, I used my phone to handle work emails, replied to client Huang Siqi and real estate agent Lu Jiaming, and reviewed the morning stock market trends. After the break, we continued driving via the Xuguang Expressway and provincial roads, arriving in Mangshan Town around 12:45. The scenery along the way gradually transitioned from plains to hills.
location: Beijing-Hong Kong-Macao Expressway (G4) Changsha to Hengyang Section, Hengshan Service Area (Southbound) on the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macao Expressway in Hengdong County, Hengyang City, Hunan Province, Xuguang Expressway (G0421), and Provincial Highway S215

name: Lunch and Final Supplies Resupply at Mangshan Town
description: The team had lunch at the "Mountain Wild Farmhouse Restaurant" in Mangshan Town, where Feng Haoran coordinated the ordering of local specialties such as stir-fried bamboo shoots with cured pork and steamed small river fish. During the meal, team members exchanged experiences about hiking and photography in a relaxed atmosphere. After the meal, the entire team walked to the local specialty supermarket in town, where they purchased additional bottled water, fruits, and energy snacks as final supplies before heading into the mountains.
location: "Shanye Farmhouse Restaurant" and Mangshan Local Specialty Shopping Supermarket on Mangshan Avenue, Mangshan Town, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province

name: Drive to the trailhead and prepare for the mountain hike.
description: The convoy departed from Mangshan Town and drove along the winding mountain road for approximately 20 minutes, arriving at the parking lot near the hiking starting point close to the east gate of Mangshan National Forest Park. All members disembarked, unloaded their personal backpacks (weighing around 15–18 kilograms) and the shared supplies from the vehicles, and made final preparations before the hike. Feng Haoran adjusted his camera to standby mode, ready for immediate use.
location: From Mangshan Town, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province to the East Gate Parking Lot of Mangshan National Forest Park

name: Backpacking to the remote mountain campsite
description: Led by Xie Yutong, the entire team, carrying their backpacks, officially set off towards the valley campsite deep in the mountains. This was a challenging backpacking hike covering approximately 3.5 kilometers with significant elevation gain. Feng Haoran, with abundant physical stamina, often walked at the front of the group, assisting in scouting the route and using his camera to document his teammates' trekking efforts as well as the natural scenery along the way. The team took two breaks during the journey to share water and replenish energy, during which Feng Haoran proactively helped teammates with slightly weaker stamina by carrying some of their supplies. The hike was filled with challenges, but the team collaboration was excellent. It took approximately 2 hours and 10 minutes, marking the completion of the core event: "Departing for Mangshan Camping."
location: From the East Gate parking lot to the designated valley campsite (off the main tourist trail) in Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City.

name: Campsite Setup and Functional Area Planning
description: Upon arriving at the campsite by the stream, the team immediately began collaborating on the setup. Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei, working as a pair, skillfully pitched the tents and demonstrated strong organizational skills by assisting in planning distinct areas for tents, cooking, and storage of supplies. They helped set up the canopy, cleared the surroundings of the campsite to ensure safety, and confirmed the locations of the water collection point and the makeshift sanitation area.
location: A flat campsite by a stream in Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Exploration and Landscape Photography around the Campsite
description: After setting up the camp, Feng Haoran, along with teammates Chen Fan and Su Rui, conducted a light exploration of the surrounding hills, forests, and valleys within a 300-meter radius of the camp. Feng Haoran’s primary objective was photography. He followed the stream to find the best compositions, capturing the sunset’s Tyndall effect, close-ups of river pebbles, and panoramic views of the campsite. During the evening’s "golden hour" light, he also took portraits of his teammates blending with nature. This activity marked the completion of the core event, "Preliminary Exploration of the Campsite."
location: The mountainous forest and stream valley area surrounding the campsite within Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Camp Dinner Preparation, Dining, and Post-Meal Socializing
description: As dusk fell, the team divided tasks to prepare dinner. Feng Haoran was responsible for boiling water using a gas stove. The meal consisted of instant noodles and rehydrated rice, accompanied by cucumbers and cherry tomatoes. Everyone gathered under the canopy to enjoy a feast in the wilderness, discussing topics ranging from outdoor gear and city life to anecdotes from the financial world and perspectives from different industries. After the meal, they cleaned the cooking utensils together, observed the Milky Way and identified constellations under the starry sky, and played a simple card game, fostering a harmonious team atmosphere.
location: At the campsite cooking area and under the canopy in Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province

name: Pre-sleep organization, daily review, and nighttime rest
description: The chill in the mountain air deepened as everyone bid each other goodnight. Inside his personal tent, Feng Haoran performed a simple cleanup with a damp towel and securely stored his important belongings. Snug in his sleeping bag, he used his phone's memo app to briefly review the key points of the day, noting down his weight, morning run, team assembly, industry exchanges, work handled at the service area, lunch replenishment, weighted hiking, campsite setup, exploration and photography, team camaraderie, and the stargazing experience. His body felt a solid weariness, yet his mind was calm and content, filled with a sense of fulfillment and the peace of being far from the hustle and bustle of the world. Lulled by the white noise of the nearby stream, he quickly drifted into a deep sleep, bringing the day's camping activities to a close.
location: In a personal tent at the campsite within Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Morning Awakening, Stretching, Breakfast, and Pre-Departure Preparation
description: Waking naturally to the birdsong in the mountains, I began with deep breaths and neck and shoulder movements inside the tent, followed by 15 minutes of full-body dynamic stretching outside the tent facing the valley, focusing on mobilizing the tight hip joints and hamstrings from yesterday's hike. Working together with my companions to prepare breakfast, Feng Haoran was responsible for frying bacon and eggs on the portable stove, while Xie Yutong cooked oatmeal porridge and added nuts and dried fruits. We chatted casually and checked our water and snack supplies. Sitting together to enjoy breakfast, Feng Haoran ate extra oatmeal porridge to stock up on carbohydrates. After the meal, I returned to the tent to check my hiking backpack (camera, lenses, filters, tripod, spare batteries, power bank, water bladder, energy foods, first aid kit, windproof jacket) and used a weather app on my phone to confirm that the probability of precipitation would increase in the afternoon.
location: Compliant camping sites and personal tents near the Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area in Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Team Pre-departure Meeting and Route Confirmation
description: The four-person team gathered around as Feng Haoran gave a brief overview of today’s hiking loop plan on the map app: starting from the campsite, passing through General’s Fortress, Tiantai Mountain, and Monkey King’s Fortress before returning to the campsite. The entire route is approximately 12 kilometers and is expected to take 5–6 hours. Everyone agreed and made a contingency plan: in case of heavy rain, they would seek the nearest shelter or retreat early.
location: Compliant Camping Site near Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area, Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province

name: Hiking to General's Fort and Exploration Photography
description: The team set out from the camp and hiked along the forest trail to the General's Fortress scenic area. Feng Haoran walked in the front-middle section of the group, adapting to the pace while using his phone to document the team's status and the surrounding vegetation. Upon arriving at General's Fortress, he entered a creative state, capturing the distinct Tyndall effect in the morning light and guiding his companions to shoot silhouettes. By the stream, he set up a tripod and used an ND filter for slow shutter photography, transforming the babbling stream into a silky texture.
location: The mountain forest trail from the campsite to the General's Stockade scenic area and the primeval forest within the General's Stockade scenic area at Mangshan National Forest Park in Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Hiking to Tiantai Mountain, Lunch and Rest
description: Ascending the steep mountain trail toward Tiantai Mountain required considerable physical exertion. Feng Haoran paused periodically to photograph the precipitous terrain and the layered mountain scenery. During breaks, he used his phone to record ambient sounds—birdsong, wind, and the heavy breathing of his companions. Upon reaching the viewing platform at the summit of Tiantai Mountain, he overlooked the panoramic view of Mangshan. He shared sandwiches, fruit, and energy bars for lunch. Feng Haoran cleaned the dust from his camera lens, quickly reviewed the slow-shutter shots of streams and mountain landscapes taken that morning, reminded everyone to hydrate, and noted the thickening cloud cover in the sky.
location: The hiking trail from General's Stockade to Tiantai Mountain and the viewing platform at the summit of Tiantai Mountain in Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Descend to the Monkey King Village, adapt to weather changes, and return to the camp.
description: We began descending toward the Monkey King Village. As the weather in the mountains is changeable in the afternoon, sporadic light rain began to fall, and everyone quickly put on their windbreakers. Feng Haoran protected his camera with a waterproof cover and captured the silhouettes of his companions walking through the misty rain near the waterfall cluster of Monkey King Village, creating a particularly evocative scene. The rain did not intensify, so we proceeded according to the original plan, completing the final leg of the loop hike and returning to the campsite. Though exhausted, we felt a profound sense of accomplishment.
location: Mangshan National Forest Park in Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province: the downhill trail from Tiantai Mountain to Houwangzhai, the Houwangzhai Scenic Area, and the mountain forest trail back to the campsite.

name: Equipment Organization, Personal Care, and Relaxation After Returning to Camp
description: After safely returning to camp, I hung the slightly damp windbreaker in a well-ventilated area of the tent and carefully wiped the camera and lens with a soft cloth. Soon after, the mild muscle soreness from the hike began to intensify, particularly in the calves and ankles, so I applied a soothing ointment in advance. I then laid out a moisture-proof mat and performed a 30-minute systematic stretching routine, focusing on relaxing the lower limb muscle groups, which helped alleviate the soreness. Next, I connected the camera to my phone, imported all the photos taken throughout the day, and selected around 20 of the most satisfying shots. After some basic color adjustments, I created an album titled "Mangshan Travelogue," shared it in the family WeChat group, and specifically tagged my mother. Finally, I sat alone at a nearby viewing platform in the camp, gazing at the distant mountains and letting my mind wander.
location: Compliant camping sites and surrounding viewing platforms near the Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area, Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Collaboration and Enjoyment of Camp Barbecue Dinner
description: The team collaborated to prepare dinner, with Feng Haoran responsible for lighting the campfire and controlling the heat for grilling. Everyone grilled and ate while sharing amusing stories from their hike. Feng Haoran used his phone to capture photos of everyone holding skewers and laughing, their faces illuminated by the glow of the campfire.
location: Compliant Campsite Cooking Area near Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area, Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province

name: Post-Meal Cleanup and Campfire Maintenance
description: The tasks of clearing the tableware, washing, and tidying up were divided among the group. Feng Haoran ensured that the residual heat from the barbecue grill dissipated and rearranged the bonfire into a stable fire pit more suitable for gathering and conversation.
location: Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province, compliant campsite cooking area near the Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area.

name: Campfire Chats and Casual Games
description: Gathered around the warm bonfire, the conversation shifted from work to life plans, with Feng Haoran sharing updates on his recent successful sale of an investment apartment. Simple games like "Guess the Movie" and "Story Relay" were played, accompanied by continuous laughter.
location: By the bonfire at the compliant campsite near the Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area, Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Stargazing and Astrophotography Attempts
description: The clouds dispersed, revealing the brilliant Milky Way, and everyone excitedly identified constellations. Feng Haoran set up a tripod and, after multiple adjustments to the parameters, successfully captured a clear outline of the Milky Way. Although the work fell short of professional standards, the process of practice brought him great satisfaction.
location: Open slope land near the compliant campsite in the Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area of Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Pre-sleep safety check, washing up, review and bedtime.
description: Returning to the campsite, Feng Haoran, as the final inspector, ensured that the campfire was completely extinguished and covered with soil. After performing a simple outdoor wash-up, he did a set of light pre-sleep stretches inside the tent and applied ointment again to massage his calves. Using the memo app on his phone, he briefly recorded the keywords of the day: "Tyndall effect, slow shutter stream, rain and mist, campfire, first attempt at starry sky photography." Reflecting on the day, he felt that both his creative drive and social needs had been greatly satisfied. Though physically tired, his mind was incredibly relaxed and content. After setting the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning, he turned off his headlamp and fell asleep to the sound of rustling pine trees.
location: Inside and around personal tents at the compliant campsite near the Mangshan Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area, Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Shooting the Sea of Clouds and Sunrise at Mangshan Mountain
description: Waking up punctually in the crisp morning mist, we headed with our companions to the designated viewing platform within Mangshan National Forest Park. There, we set up our cameras and tripods, waiting to capture the magnificent scene of golden sunlight piercing through the sea of clouds and illuminating the mountains at sunrise, serving as the perfect finale to this camping trip.
location: Observation deck near Monkey Village or Tiantai Mountain in Mangshan National Forest Park, Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province

name: Packing Up Camping Gear and Having Breakfast at the Campsite
description: Upon returning to the camp, we worked together with our companions to gather and pack personal equipment such as tents, sleeping bags, and moisture-proof pads. We used a portable stove to heat milk, which we paired with bread and instant oatmeal as a simple breakfast. Meanwhile, we thoroughly cleaned up all camp waste to ensure no trace was left in the mountains. Throughout this process, muscle soreness was noticeably felt.
location: The campsite from the previous night at Mangshan National Forest Park in Yizhang County, Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

name: Hike down to the parking lot.
description: Carrying the packed equipment, I hiked along the mountain trail with Xie Yutong for about an hour back to the parking lot of Mangshan Forest Park. Although my legs were sore, the pleasant scenery and my eagerness to return made the journey tolerable.
location: Mangshan National Forest Park Hiking Trail to Mangshan Forest Park Parking Lot

name: Self-driving back to Changsha
description: Departing from the parking lot of Mangshan Forest Park, we drove back to Changsha along the G0421 Xuguang Expressway/Beijing–Hong Kong–Macau Expressway. We stopped at the Yizhang Service Area for about 20 minutes to refuel and rest, as the long drive was a test for our sore lower backs. During the journey, we exchanged thoughts with Xie Yutong about the camping experience and photography works, and discussed our respective work schedules for the following week. Upon arriving in Changsha, we first dropped Xie Yutong off at her residence in Yuhua District before returning to our home in Yuelu District.
location: En route from the Mangshan Forest Park parking lot to Yuelu District, Changsha City, passing through Yizhang Service Area.

name: Initial Home Organization and Recovery Stretching
description: Upon arriving home, promptly place the dirty laundry into the washing machine and take a quick hot shower to wash away fatigue. Then, perform approximately 15 minutes of targeted stretching on the living room carpet, focusing on relaxing the noticeably sore muscles in the posterior thighs, glutes, and back. After stretching, the soreness is slightly alleviated.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Cleaning camping gear and accidentally breaking the phone
description: Spread out and air the core equipment such as tents, sleeping bags, and moisture-proof mats on the balcony, and wipe down small items like trekking poles and headlamps; while moving the heavy backpack, accidentally knocked the main phone (iPhone 14 Pro) placed on the edge of the coffee table to the ground. The phone fell face down on the tile floor, resulting in severe screen shattering, colored streaks appearing on the inner screen, and complete touchscreen failure.
location: On the balcony and in the living room of the home at Juxing Residential Community for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Assess Mobile Phone Status and Activate Backup Device
description: After calmly checking the phone for damage and attempting a forced restart, the touchscreen remained unresponsive, leading to the conclusion that official repair costs would be extremely high. Decisively, the backup phone (iPhone 12) was retrieved, the SIM card inserted, and the device powered on. Priority was given to re-logging into core work applications such as WeChat, WeCom, email, and Flush to ensure the restoration of communication channels for Monday's work. Concurrently, the price of the iPhone 15 Pro was browsed on the JD.com app, with plans to visit a physical store the following day for inspection before making a purchase decision.
location: Home Study, Jinsing Residential Community for Government Employees, Yuelu District, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Simple Lunch
description: It was already past the normal mealtime, and the hunger was quite noticeable. Using ingredients from the refrigerator, I quickly stir-fried some egg fried rice and made seaweed soup, devouring the meal to settle my lunch.
location: In the kitchen and living room of the home at Jinying Residential Compound for Government Employees, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province.

name: Going out to a coffee shop
description: Considering muscle soreness and the intention to drink coffee, I used the Amap app to book a ride-hailing service. The car arrived approximately 15 minutes later, and the journey took about 15 minutes to reach the familiar "Yidan Coffee Shop."
location: From home to "Yidan Cafe" on Liuyanghe Avenue, Furong District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Relax at the café and contact friends to arrange dinner plans.
description: I ordered a cup of sun-dried Yirgacheffe pour-over coffee recommended by the owner, Shen Xinyi. While savoring the coffee, I used a backup phone to check unread messages from the weekend and updates in work group chats, and briefly organized previews of sunrise photos stored in the camera. I chatted briefly with Shen Xinyi about recent happenings, sharing stories from my trip to Mangshan and the minor incident of my phone screen shattering. Later, I used the backup phone to send a WeChat message to my friend Peng Yuqing, inviting her to dinner and agreeing to meet at our usual Hunan restaurant in half an hour.
location: "Yidan Cafe" on Liuyanghe Avenue, Furong District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Head to the dinner venue
description: Using the Amap app again to book a ride-hailing service, I headed to the Hunan restaurant arranged with Peng Yuqing. There was slight congestion during the evening rush hour, and the journey took approximately 25 minutes.
location: From Yidan Cafe to "Xiang Cuisine Restaurant, West Lake Jianxin Resettlement Community", Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Sharing stories over dinner with friends
description: I met Peng Yuqing at a Hunan restaurant, where we ordered classic dishes such as stir-fried beef with chili, steamed fish head with chopped chili, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. During the meal, Feng Haoran showed photos of the sunrise at Mangshan Mountain and his hike in the misty rain on his backup phone. He vividly recounted the fun of camping and the thrilling experience on the winding mountain road, while also complaining about the minor inconvenience caused by accidentally breaking his phone. Peng Yuqing shared updates about her work and some gossip. The two had a delightful conversation, toasting with tea instead of wine. Their fatigue was alleviated by the delicious food and the warmth of friendship.
location: "West Lake Jianxin Resettlement Community Hunan Cuisine Restaurant" on Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

They drove along routes such as the North Second Ring Road and Furong North Road toward Wangcheng District, a journey lasting approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. During the trip, Feng Haoran used his phone to capture snapshots of the pastoral scenery and distant mountains outside the window. Upon arriving at the North Gate parking lot of Hei Mifeng Forest Park, the group gathered to purchase tickets (including entrance tickets and vehicle entry permits). As it was nearing noon, they bought instant noodles, corn, and other food items from a small shop near the visitor center. They quickly had lunch in a shaded rest area and confirmed the route to their campsite.
location: From No. 228 Yinpenling Street, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province to Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, near the North Gate entrance area and tourist service center of Heimifeng National Forest Park.

name: Arrive at the campsite and set up camp efficiently
description: After driving along the park's winding mountain road for about 20 minutes, we arrived at the pre-booked "Stargazing Camping Base" halfway up the mountain. Everyone got out of the vehicle to unload the supplies. Feng Haoran, demonstrating the planning and execution skills typical of an ENTJ, quickly mapped out the campsite layout (tent area, canopy common area, cooking area) and assigned clear roles: he and Gao Yunfei were responsible for setting up the tents and canopy frames, while Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong were in charge of laying out the moisture-proof mats, arranging tables and chairs, and organizing the shared items. A well-zoned campsite was swiftly established. After the setup, everyone took a short break to drink water and eat some fruit. Meanwhile, Feng Haoran used this time to retrieve the photography equipment from the vehicle, store it in the tent, and conduct a final equipment check in preparation for the night's stargazing photography.
location: Campsite A03, Starry Sky Camping Base, Hei Mifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Mountain Hiking and Themed Photography Field Trips
description: Traveling light, embark on an approximately three-hour hike along a clearly marked circular forest trail near the campsite. The trail winds through the woods, passing by mountain streams and offering expansive views of the reservoir. Feng Haoran, carrying a camera, serves as both a participant and a documentarian. He captures the interplay of light and shadow in the forest, the joyful moments of his friends, and pays special attention to mountain paths and stone steps with strong linear and depth qualities, seeking inspiration for his photography theme "Roads and Change" in a mountainous, forested context.
location: Forest hiking trail starting from the Stargazing Camping Base within Heimi Peak National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Return to the campsite and initiate dinner barbecue preparations.
description: After returning from the hike, everyone took a brief rest before starting dinner preparations. Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei were responsible for building a stable charcoal fire using a fire pit and eco-friendly charcoal. Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong handled vegetables, washed fruits, and prepared salads on a folding table. Feng Haoran retrieved marinated meats such as steak, lamb chops, and chicken wings from the insulated container and arranged them for cooking. As the sun set, the campsite was bathed in golden light, with wisps of cooking smoke rising, creating a warm and cozy atmosphere.
location: Campsite A03, Starry Sky Camping Base, Hei Mifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Collaborative Outdoor Barbecue Dinner
description: Feng Haoran took the initiative to serve as the "head grill master," skillfully flipping the steaks and chicken wings while controlling the heat, with Gao Yunfei assisting nearby. The sizzling sound and aroma of the barbecue filled the campsite. Everyone gathered around the grill, sipping drinks and chatting freely about recent work and amusing life anecdotes. The grilled delicacies were paired with refreshing salads, and under the sunset and mountain breeze, they enjoyed an exceptionally satisfying outdoor feast.
location: Campsite A03, Starry Sky Camping Base, Hei Mifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Post-Meal Cleanup and Campfire Preparation
description: After dinner, everyone worked together to quickly wash the dishes, sort and pack the kitchen waste, ensuring the campsite remained clean and tidy. Subsequently, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei gathered firewood and built a bonfire in the designated safe area, preparing for the upcoming evening conversation around the fire. As dusk fell, a chill began to settle over the mountains.
location: Campsite A03, Starry Sky Camping Base, Hei Mifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Campfire Night Talks and In-depth Exchanges
description: The bonfire was lit, its leaping flames becoming a center of warmth and light. The four of them sat around the fire, their conversation shifting from amusing anecdotes about daily work and industry insights to gradually encompassing life ideals and future travel plans. Feng Haoran shared his career advancement plan (Investment Director) for the next three years, along with his thoughts on balancing high-intensity work with his passion for photography. His friends offered positive encouragement and suggestions.
location: Beside the campfire at Campsite A03, Stargazing Camping Base, Heimi Peak National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: First Attempt at Starry Sky Photography with Light Painting Interaction
description: As the Milky Way gradually emerged, Feng Haoran picked up his photography equipment and walked to a dark open area about 80 meters away from the camp lights. He quickly set up the tripod and conducted a test shot based on the parameters suggested by the starry sky app (ISO 3200, f/2.8, 20 seconds). While waiting for the camera playback, he returned to the campfire and organized his friends for light painting photography. After setting up the camera, he asked Gao Yunfei and Peng Yuqing to use high-power flashlights to draw patterns and letters in the air, capturing several creative and joyful photos that combined astrophotography with interactive moments among friends.
location: Light-free open space near Campsite A03, Stargazing Camping Base, Heimi Peak National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha City, Hunan Province.

name: Focusing on Starry Sky Time-Lapse Photography and Intermittent Social Interaction
description: After returning to the photography spot, Feng Haoran began the formal sequence of starry sky time-lapse photography, setting the interval shooting mode to capture star trails. He then returned to the campfire to continue participating in conversations with his friends, sharing photography insights and observations. During this time, he stood up approximately every 20 minutes to check the camera’s status, making slight adjustments to the composition or parameters. In doing so, he found a balance between focusing on his personal hobby (astrophotography) and socializing with friends. The night sky was as dark as ink, with stars shining brilliantly.

Afterward, they thoroughly doused the embers with water to ensure safety. All food scraps were packed into containers to prevent attracting animals, and they performed a simple personal cleanup before preparing for sleep.

name: Second Rest and Energy Replenishment at the Service Area
description: We entered the service area again for a break. By this time, we had already ventured deep into western Hunan, where the air was noticeably fresher and cooler. Feng Haoran took several photos of the distant, layered mountain scenery with his mobile phone. Everyone shared the local specialty snack purchased at the service area—wormwood herb cakes—and briefly discussed the arrangements for the afternoon after arrival.
location: Luxi County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province, Luxi Service Area of Hangzhou-Ruili Expressway (toward Hangzhou)

name: Final leg of the journey: Arrival at Fenghuang Ancient Town
description: Exit the highway and pass through the Phoenix Toll Station. Follow the navigation to the reserved ancient city parking lot (near Hongqiao Middle Road). As we approach the destination, everyone grows excited. Feng Haoran parks the car steadily in the parking lot, concluding the self-driving journey that lasted approximately 6 hours and 40 minutes in total.
location: Hongqiao Middle Road, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province, Fenghuang Ancient Town Parking Lot

name: Check in at the Riverside Inn on foot
description: Dragging his luggage, he walked through the stone-paved road and alleys at the entrance of the ancient town, and found the inn by the Tuo River according to the reservation information. While checking in, Feng Haoran briefly exchanged words with the enthusiastic innkeeper, inquiring about recommended nearby restaurants and less crowded photography spots in the early morning. After settling in, he briefly organized his luggage in the room.
location: "Qingfeng Xiaozhu" Riverside Inn, Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Inform family of safe arrival
description: Pushing open the wooden window, the scenery of the Tuo River came into view. He sent his parents in Wuhan and his sister in Shanghai a WeChat location pin along with the message "Arrived safely in Fenghuang," accompanied by a photo of the river view taken from his room's window.
location: Inside the Riverside Inn "Qingfeng Xiaozhu" room at Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Preliminary Reconnaissance and Thematic Research of the Ancient City
description: Execute the event "Arrive at Fenghuang Ancient Town and Conduct Preliminary Fieldwork." Feng Haoran slung his camera over his shoulder and set out with his friend Gao Yunfei for a purposeful "reconnaissance": observing the composition of the afternoon light and the stilted houses from the Rainbow Bridge; marking camera positions near the Tuojiang River's stepping stones with the Longevity Palace as the backdrop; capturing humanistic elements such as sketching students and local residents; and roughly mapping out the riverside route from the Rainbow Bridge to the Myriad Pagoda, planning two alternative routes, A and B, for early morning photography the following day. Throughout the process, he continuously recorded his observations and insights in his phone's memo app.
location: Core Area of Fenghuang Ancient Town: Rainbow Bridge, East Gate Tower, Tuojiang River Stepping Stones, North Gate Wharf

name: Taste the local specialty dinner.
description: Meeting up with friends, we found this local restaurant based on the innkeeper's recommendation. We ordered signature dishes such as duck with blood cake, sour soup fish, and stir-fried preserved pork with fern shoots. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, with everyone sharing their experiences from the afternoon.
location: Teng Mazi Local Cuisine Restaurant, Shop 4-7, South Hua Road (Former Justice Bureau), Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Experience the Atmosphere of the Ancient City on a Night Tour
description: After dinner, the group strolled along the Tuo River. The ancient town was brilliantly lit at night, its lights shimmering in the river's reflection. Feng Haoran had only brought his phone this time and, adopting a tourist's mindset, casually captured some shots of the illuminated night scenes and bustling streets, focusing more on experiencing the vibrant nightlife of the ancient town.
location: Night View Areas of Fenghuang Ancient Town: Both Banks of Tuo River, Surroundings of Hongqiao Bridge, Alleys

name: Return to the inn to organize materials and plan for the next day.
description: He returned to the inn to take a shower. Then, he transferred the photos from his camera and phone to the tablet, quickly reviewed all the footage captured that day, deleted the unusable shots, and made a preliminary selection of promising photos. Based on the notes he had taken during the day, he outlined a detailed plan for the next morning’s shoot on the tablet: Theme: "Fenghuang in the Morning Glow"; Time: Depart at 6:30; Key Route: From the North Gate Pier to the Rainbow Bridge.
location: Inside the Riverside Inn room of "Qingfeng Xiaozhu" at Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Relaxation and Reading Before Sleep
description: After completing the planning, he felt a sense of satisfaction from having control over tomorrow's tasks. To relax his nerves, he put on headphones to listen to light music and browsed through past issues of the electronic book "National Geographic," seeking inspiration for landscape photography.
location: Inside the Riverside Inn room of "Qingfeng Xiaozhu" at Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Preparing for Bed
description: He set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning, checked that the doors and windows were securely closed, turned off the lights, and prepared to rest. Outside the window, the faint sound of the Tuo River flowing could be heard. With anticipation for the next day's shoot, he drifted into sleep.
location: Inside the Riverside Inn "Qingfeng Xiaozhu" Room at Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Morning preparation for photography creation with the morning mist over the Tuojiang River
description: Woken by the alarm, I promptly got up, checked the camera and drone equipment, and cleaned the lenses. After changing into quick-drying clothes and hiking shoes, I walked about 10 minutes to the shooting location along the lower reaches of the Tuo River for morning mist photography. Using long exposure, I captured the mist-shrouded Tuo River and the reflections of the stilted buildings, while operating the drone for aerial panoramic shots. Simultaneously, I used a telephoto lens to capture scenes of residents' daily lives. After the sunlight dispersed the morning mist, I walked back to the guesthouse, purchasing wormwood cakes along the way for an energy boost. The entire process was focused and efficient, reflecting a passion for photography and strong planning skills.
location: From Fenghuang Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay at No. 14 Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province, to the Tuojiang River waterfront (from Feng Bridge to Hong Bridge section).

name: Morning Routine and Financial Information Review
description: After returning to the homestay room, charge the batteries of the photography equipment and take a quick shower for cleanliness. Use a mobile phone to browse overnight summaries of major global market indices and key financial news, maintaining attention to financial markets and preserving professional sensitivity as a financial advisor.
location: Room at Fenghuang Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay, No. 14 Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Breakfast and Itinerary Discussion with Friends
description: Walk about 10 minutes to the time-honored specialty noodle restaurant on South Street to meet up with friends Wu Junjie and Gao Yunfei. Order the signature beef noodles for breakfast. While eating, exchange observations from the morning. Feng Haoran shares preview images of the morning fog captured on his phone, and the group discusses the day's subsequent arrangements, reflecting social interaction.
location: No. 29 Nanbian Street, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province, Nanbian Street Old Brand Special Rice Noodle Restaurant

name: Street Photography with a Humanistic Documentary Theme
description: After breakfast, I temporarily bid farewell to my friends and walked about 15 minutes into the non-core areas of the ancient town, such as Shijia Lane, to conduct street photography focused on humanistic documentation. Avoiding tourists, I concentrated on capturing the details of local residents' lives, such as an elderly man weaving bamboo baskets, children playing, and weathered brick walls. Using street photography mode, I emphasized storytelling and the essence of daily life, complementing the morning scenic photography.
location: Shijia Lane and Wenxing Street area in the ancient town of Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Special Lunch and Family Connection
description: Walk approximately 15 minutes to the Ambassador Hotel to meet friends for lunch, which is famous for its duck with blood cakes. While waiting for the dishes to be served, Feng Haoran sends his mother WeChat messages sharing cultural photos and sends a voice message to inform her of his safety. During lunch, they discuss the afternoon activity arrangements, combining family communication and socializing.
location: Ambassador Restaurant (Phoenix Ancient Town Pedestrian Street Branch), No. 118 Hongqiao Middle Road, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Midday Nap and Photography Material Backup
description: After lunch, walk about 15 minutes back to the homestay. In the room, transfer the photos taken in the morning to both the laptop and the external hard drive for dual backup to ensure data security. After completing this, set a half-hour alarm and lie down on the bed for a short nap to regain energy.
location: Inside the Phoenix Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay Room, No. 14 Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Preliminary Photo Selection and Leisure at the Cafe
description: After a short rest, I walked to the public coffee area of the homestay and ordered a pour-over coffee. Opening my laptop, I conducted a preliminary selection of the hundreds of photos taken in the early morning and late morning, quickly discarding unusable shots. I categorized them into "Morning Mist Landscapes" and "Humanistic Documentary," and marked 10–15 standout images as initial selections. The process was rational and efficient, while still allowing me to enjoy a leisurely moment.
location: Public Coffee Area, Phoenix Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay, No. 14 Laoyingshao, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Nanhua Mountain Light Hiking and Ancient City Panoramic Photography
description: Together with my friend Gao Yunfei, I walked for about 20 minutes to the entrance of Nanhua Mountain National Forest Park and chose a gentle trail for a light hike of approximately one hour. Upon reaching the observation deck, I overlooked the panoramic view of the ancient town of Fenghuang. Feng Haoran used his equipment to capture the full view of the ancient town under the afternoon sunlight, creating a contrast with the morning mist scenery. The activity promoted physical and mental relaxation and provided a natural experience.
location: Nanhua Mountain National Forest Park, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Purchase local specialties and return to the homestay.
description: After descending the mountain, I walked for about 20 minutes to a specialty shop near the Ancient Town Rainbow Bridge to select Fenghuang ginger candy and cured meat gift boxes for my colleague Zheng Wenbo and supervisor Mr. Qian in Changsha. After the purchase, I walked for approximately 10 minutes to carry the specialty products back to the homestay, where I tidied up briefly, demonstrating consideration for interpersonal relationships.
location: From the South China Mountain National Forest Park to the specialty shops near the Rainbow Bridge in the Ancient Town of Fenghuang (such as the Fenghuang branch of Shunhua Xiangpin Hall), and then returning to the Fenghuang Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay.

name: Dinner and Deep Socializing
description: Walk approximately 10 minutes to a specialty restaurant near Hongqiao Middle Road to meet up with friends Wu Junjie and Gao Yunfei. Order Miao ethnic dishes such as jar-cultivated mushrooms and rice tofu. During dinner, the conversation expands from travel experiences to recent work updates and future plans. Feng Haoran shares observations on recent financial market trends, facilitating in-depth social interaction.
location: Specialty restaurants near Hongqiao Middle Road in Fenghuang Ancient Town (such as Wanmuzhai or other Miao cuisine restaurants)

name: Night Tour of the Tuo River and Relaxing Meditation
description: After dinner, I took a walk with friends along the riverside promenade in the Shawan area on the opposite bank of the Tuo River, admiring the brilliant lights of the ancient town under the night sky. Finding a stone step to sit on, I quietly enjoyed the view, allowing the excitement of the day to settle and promoting relaxation and emotional connection.
location: The Riverside Promenade in the Shawan Area on the Opposite Bank of the Tuojiang River, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Return to the homestay and browse the photos.
description: After the night tour, it took about a 10-minute walk back to the homestay. Inside the room, I turned on the computer and quickly browsed through the outstanding photos selected earlier in the afternoon. I added simple keyword tags to the most satisfactory ones, deliberately limiting the time to within half an hour to avoid deep editing that might overstimulate the mind.
location: Room at Fenghuang Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay, No. 14 Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Video call with father to discuss investments.
description: Had a video call with my father, Feng Jianguo, sharing travel experiences and photography results. My father inquired about my views on the post-holiday market trends, and we briefly exchanged investment perspectives, reflecting both family care and professional discussion. My father reminded me to get enough rest and drive safely on the return trip.
location: Room of Fenghuang Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay, No. 14 Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Falling asleep after bedtime reading and sleep preparation.
description: After washing up, I leaned against the bed and read *The Most Important Thing* for about 20 minutes. Then, I turned off all electronic screens, put on noise-canceling headphones to play white noise, and performed a 5-minute deep-breathing meditation to help me fall asleep. However, due to the rich visual stimulation and creative satisfaction experienced during the day, my brain remained slightly active, leading to mild insomnia. After tossing and turning, I eventually fell asleep in a state of contentment mixed with slight exhaustion.
location: Room at Fenghuang Shadow Coffee Riverside Homestay, No. 14 Laoyingshao, Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Morning Wake-up and Planning
description: Feng Haoran woke up in his room at the Riverside Inn in Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Hunan Province. After washing up, he stood by the window to take deep breaths and do stretches as a substitute for his interrupted morning run. Using the mobile app Amap, he carefully planned the self-driving route from Fenghuang to Zhenyuan (via National Highway G354 and Provincial Highway S308), estimating the total travel time and possible rest stops.
location: A riverside inn room in Tuojiang Town, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Breakfast Service and Hotel Check-out
description: Feng Haoran, along with his friends Wu Junjie and Gao Yunfei, walked to Jixin Noodle House for breakfast. Feng Haoran ordered the signature beef noodles, which tasted authentic. After the meal, they returned to the inn where they had been staying, quickly packed their personal belongings and photography equipment, and checked out. He made sure to double-check that the specialty gift boxes purchased for his colleagues the previous day had been properly packed into his luggage.
location: Jixin Noodle Restaurant at No. 13 Fenghuang South Road, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province, and the Front Desk of the Former Guesthouse

name: Pick up the vehicle and conduct an inspection before departure.
description: The three of them walked with their luggage to the Chestnut Bay Parking Lot in Fenghuang Ancient Town. As the main driver, Feng Haoran skillfully checked the fuel level, tire pressure, lights, and the secure loading of the luggage in the rental vehicle. He set the mobile navigation to the "Guizhou Zhenyuan Ancient Town Cultural Park Parking Lot" and selected the "Avoid Highways" option to enjoy the scenery along the way.
location: Liwan Parking Lot, Fenghuang Ancient Town, No. 20 Jinping Road, Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Self-driving departure with drone aerial photography en route.
description: Feng Haoran drove away from Fenghuang, entered the hilly areas of Xiangxi along National Highway G354, and enjoyed the sense of control while driving, with electronic music playing in the car. After approximately 1.5 hours of driving, he parked near the "Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea Viewing Platform," launched a drone to capture panoramic shots of the winding mountain roads and distant villages, which took about 25 minutes. Gao Yunfei used his phone to take work photos of Feng Haoran focusing on operating the drone.
location: National Highway G354 (Fenghuang to Tongren Section) and near the Baxianguohai Viewing Platform on County Road 121 in Fenghuang County, Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province

name: Continue driving and enter the Guizhou boundary, social connections.
description: Continuing along Provincial Highway S308, the scenery gradually changes. Feng Haoran hands over the driving duties to Wu Junjie at a safe section of the road, taking a rest himself to enjoy the view. He uses the time to send aerial preview images to his mother and the work group chat (including Mr. Qian and Zheng Wenbo), accompanied by the message: "We have entered Guizhou province. The mountains and rivers are magnificent, and all is well."
location: Provincial Highway S308 (Section at the Hunan-Guizhou Border)

name: Simple Meals and Supply Purchases in Towns Along the Way
description: The three of them parked and dined at a clean and tidy farmhouse restaurant by the provincial highway, ordering stir-fried pork with green peppers, farmhouse-style stir-fried pork, sautéed wild vegetables, and tofu soup. Feng Haoran consciously controlled his rice intake and reminded his friends, "We'll have a proper dinner when we reach Zhenyuan." After the meal, they purchased mineral water and energy bars as supplies from the neighboring convenience store.
location: A farmhouse restaurant by a provincial highway in Yuping Dong Autonomous County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province (near the reference location of Yanghe Farmhouse Restaurant and Accommodation)

name: Arrive at Zhenyuan Ancient Town and park the vehicle.
description: We continued driving in the afternoon and arrived at Zhenyuan Ancient Town around 14:30. Due to the large number of tourists during the National Day holiday, parking spaces were limited. Feng Haoran patiently searched and eventually parked the car at the 'Zhenyuan Ancient Town Cultural Park Parking Lot,' carefully noting the parking area number and nearby landmarks.
location: Provincial Highway S306 (Zhenyuan Section) and the Parking Lot of Zhenyuan Ancient Town Cultural Park, Panlong Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Walk to the inn and check in.
description: Dragging the luggage along the Wuyang River for about 15 minutes, we arrived at the pre-booked "Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay." The inn, a renovated old house built by the river, offered a tranquil environment. During check-in, Feng Haoran proactively engaged with the innkeeper, inquiring about the best section of the Wuyang River for evening photography, local-frequented sour fish soup restaurants, and the morning mist conditions the next day. The innkeeper enthusiastically marked the locations on a map.
location: From the Parking Lot of Zhenyuan Ancient Town Cultural Park to Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Settle the luggage and organize the photography equipment.
description: After placing luggage in designated areas within the room, he arranged all photography equipment in a line on the desk: checking the battery levels of the Sony A7IV and Fujifilm X-T5 and connecting them to power banks, backing up the footage captured yesterday in Fenghuang from memory cards to both an external hard drive and laptop, and then clearing the memory cards. This process swiftly shifted him into "photographer readiness mode" and gave him a sense of control over the workspace in the room.
location: Room, Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Take a short afternoon nap and contact family and colleagues.
description: After tidying up the equipment, I felt a bit tired and leaned against the headboard to rest with my eyes closed for 20 minutes. Then, I replied to my mother’s caring WeChat message and checked the work group chat again for replies from Mr. Qian and Zheng Wenbo. After sending brief responses, I began planning the evening walking route.
location: Room, Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Evening Street Photography Reconnaissance in Zhenyuan Ancient Town
description: I took my Fujifilm X-T5 with a telephoto lens for a walk along the Wuyang River, observing and photographing in the soft sunlight. Using the telephoto lens, I captured scenes of daily life from a distance: villagers packing fishing gear by the dock, women washing clothes on the riverside stone steps, and elderly people chatting in groups at the entrance of an alley. I paid special attention to the interplay of light and shadow on the horse-head walls of Huizhou-style architecture and noted several key shooting locations for the next day in my phone's memo app, such as compositions featuring the Zhusheng Bridge and Shiping Mountain. The walk lasted over two hours, providing a good amount of exercise and serving as a warm-up for tomorrow's photography session.
location: Pedestrian walkways along the Wuyang River in Zhenyuan Ancient Town, Chongzikou Wharf, Fuxing Alley, Renshou Alley, etc.

name: Enjoy Zhenyuan Sour Fish Soup for dinner.
description: Upon the innkeeper's recommendation, the three found a sour fish soup restaurant frequented by locals and ordered the Zhenyuan specialty—red sour soup with catfish, accompanied by tofu and a vegetable platter. Feng Haoran enjoyed the social time, discussing the day's experiences and the similarities and differences between Fenghuang and Zhenyuan. He paid attention to his diet management, mainly eating fish and vegetables, having only a small bowl of rice, and jokingly remarked, "Today's exercise should offset this big meal."
location: A sour fish soup restaurant in Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province, recommended by a local (referring to the reputation of Miao-style sour fish soup).

name: Return to the inn and enjoy coffee by the river.
description: After dinner, take a leisurely walk back to the inn. On the inn's riverside balcony, against the backdrop of the dazzling night view of the Wuyang River and the warm glow of distant lanterns, carefully brew a cup of Yirgacheffe coffee using a travel-sized pour-over set. Then, import the evening street photos into the iPad Pro for a quick review, without making detailed selections—simply star a few photos that capture vivid expressions to achieve complete relaxation.
location: Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province, with riverside balcony or public area

name: Wash up, plan tomorrow's shooting, and read.
description: After freshening up, I leaned against the bed in comfortable pajamas. In my portable notebook, I briefly outlined the shooting plan for the next day: early morning (6:30) for the morning mist and fishermen on the Wuyang River, morning (9:00) for in-depth documentary photography of the alleyways, and afternoon (15:00) for capturing panoramic views of the ancient town from a high vantage point. The planning took only 10 minutes, leaving room for flexibility. Then, I opened my e-reader and continued reading *The Most Important Thing* for about 20 minutes to help settle my thoughts.
location: Room, Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Sleep Preparation and Meditation
description: Turn off the main light and switch on the warm bedside night light. Engage in five minutes of deep-breathing meditation, reflecting on today's fulfilling transitions and initial explorations, while looking forward to tomorrow's shoot. Ensure to fall asleep by 22:30 to conserve energy for tomorrow's creative work.
location: Room, Zhenyuan Fangju Hostel, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Morning Preparation and Inn Breakfast
description: Feng Haoran woke up on time, performed morning stretches, and checked his photography equipment. He then quickly ate congee, pickles, and boiled eggs in the inn's dining area, while confirming the morning shooting route and convenience store location with the owner.
location: Room 301 and the Restaurant on the First Floor, Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Wuyang Town, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Wuyang River Morning Light Humanistic Photography
description: Photograph along the ancient lanes and stone steps on the east bank of the Wuyang River, capturing the stilted houses in the morning light, women washing clothes, and vegetable farmers. To photograph the ancient architectural complex of Qinglong Cave, place the camera bag beside the viewing stone steps.
location: Near the ancient lanes, stone steps, and Yumen Dock on the east bank of the Wuyang River, Wuyang Town, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province.

name: Loss and Goodwill Recovery of Photography Equipment
description: After the shoot, I discovered my camera bag was missing and anxiously retraced my steps to search for it. I found it at the scenic stone steps, where a local auntie had kindly kept watch over it. Feng Haoran was immensely grateful and immediately went to a nearby shop to purchase apples, oranges, and children's cheese sticks as tokens of appreciation. He thanked the auntie once more, bid her farewell, and checked that all his equipment was intact.
location: From the shooting point at Yumen Wharf to the viewing stone steps, and Fuxing Lane in Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province, Shiming Small Shop

name: Emergency Data Backup and Meeting Up with Friends
description: Return to the inn room and perform a dual backup of this morning's and previous shooting materials onto the mobile hard drive. Notify friends in the WeChat group to gather in the lobby at 10 a.m. for departure.
location: Room 301, Zhenyuan Fangju Hostel, No. 2 Xixiu Street, Wuyang Town, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province

name: Check out and inspect the vehicle
description: Meet up with friends Wu Junjie and Gao Yunfei, and complete the check-out procedures. As the main driver, Feng Haoran performs a walk-around inspection to check tire pressure, lights, and other aspects, confirms the fuel tank is full, and prepares to set off.
location: No. 2 Xixiu Street, Wuyang Town, Zhenyuan County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province, Front Desk and Parking Lot of Zhenyuan Fangju Homestay

name: Self-driving transfer to Mount Fanjing.
description: Driving from Zhenyuan Ancient Town towards Fanjing Mountain, we traveled on the highway with music playing in the car. Feng Haoran was driving, and Wu Junjie was navigating. Around 12:30, we had lunch at the "Farmhouse Kitchen" restaurant in Taiping Town, Jiangkou County, ordering stir-fried pork with green peppers, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and vegetable tofu soup. Afterward, we continued the journey and arrived at the parking lot of the Fanjing Mountain scenic area.
location: Along the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, Jiangdu Expressway, and Hangzhou-Ruili Expressway, near Taiping Town, Jiangkou County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province, as well as at Fanjingshan Village, Taiping Town, Jiangkou County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province, and the East Mountain Gate parking lot of the Fanjingshan Scenic Area.

name: Hiking and Photographing at Mount Fanjing
description: Take the scenic shuttle to the starting point of the hike and begin ascending Mount Fanjing. Capture the interplay of light and shadow in the forest along the way, as well as photos of companions. After approximately three hours of climbing, reach the summit area. Wait near the Mushroom Stone to capture the magnificent moment of the Red Cloud Golden Summit emerging from the sea of clouds, and photograph the silhouettes of climbers. The three of us reached the summit of the Old Golden Peak and took a group photo.
location: Jiangkou County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province, within the Fanjing Mountain Scenic Area: hiking trails, Mushroom Stone, and Laojinding area

name: Return to the parking lot by descending the mountain.
description: After hiking down the mountain, they took the sightseeing bus back to the parking lot at the East Mountain Gate. After retrieving the car, Feng Haoran felt soreness in his legs but was mentally exhilarated. He started the vehicle and drove toward the accommodation.
location: Mount Fanjing Scenic Area downhill trail, sightseeing bus boarding point, return to parking lot

name: Arriving at Zhaisha Dong Village and checking into the homestay
description: It takes approximately 20 minutes to drive from the Fanjing Mountain parking lot to the Fanjing Mountain Pusu Homestay in Zhaisha Dong Village. Upon arrival, check-in will be completed, and the rooms feature a traditional Dong wooden architectural style. The three individuals will return to their respective rooms to freshen up and change into comfortable clothes to relieve the fatigue from hiking.
location: From the parking lot of the Fanjing Mountain Scenic Area to Zhaisa Dong Village, Taiping Town, Jiangkou County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province, and the front desk and guest rooms of Fanjing Mountain Pusu Homestay

name: Tujia Cuisine Dinner and Daytime Sharing
description: We dined at a local Tujia restaurant recommended by the homestay owner, ordering dishes such as stir-fried cured pork with fern root cake and sour soup with horned fish. During dinner, friends discussed the experience of losing equipment during the day and the beautiful scenery of Mount Fanjing. Feng Haoran provided a detailed account of the kind-hearted aunt's goodwill.
location: Zhaisha Dong Village, Taiping Town, Jiangkou County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province, Zuixianlou Old Stove Firewood Chicken. Farmhouse Cuisine (actually a local Tujia restaurant in the village)

name: Voice-sharing the day's ups and downs with close friends
description: After returning to his room, Feng Haoran called his friend Peng Yuqing on WeChat voice chat. He recounted the entire process of losing and retrieving the equipment, expressing his lingering fear, relief, and gratitude. He also shared photos of Fanjing Mountain.
location: Room on the second floor of Fanjing Mountain Pusu Homestay, Zhaisha Dong Village, Taiping Town, Jiangkou County, Tongren City, Guizhou Province

name: Import and Organization of Daily Photography Materials
description: Import the footage from the camera and GoPro into the laptop, browse and categorize it into folders such as "Zhenyuan Morning Shots" and "Fanjingshan Scenery," then back it up again to the external hard drive.
